filename: T2 - Posterior fossa ependymoma ventricle , supratentorial 011.jpg
description: Pre and post-contrast MRI shows a heterogeneously hyperintense signal lesion on the T2WI in the midline fourth ventricle, with intratumoral hemorrhage and internal cystic components. After the administration of contrast, the lesion shows irregular enhancement with non-enhancing cystic components — the mass results in obstructive supratentorial hydrocephalus, with mild dilatation of the third and lateral ventricles.
